author: AAswordsman & luojiaping & 空悲切 & zjxdzh & 芸

description.zh: 在 Operit 侧边栏中承载本机 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面，并提供服务控制、对话工具和内置 Sub-Agent 监控面板。
description.en: Embeds the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI with service controls, conversation tools, and a built-in Sub-Agent monitor.
description.default: Embeds the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI with service controls, conversation tools, and a built-in Sub-Agent monitor.

description.zh: 查询、启动、重启和停止本机 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务。
description.en: Inspects, starts, restarts, and stops the local DeepSeek Harness Web service.

description.zh: 通过本机 DeepSeek Harness Web RPC 读取或设置界面主题、管理工作区、创建或复用会话，并发送消息后返回最终回复。
description.en: Read or set the interface theme, manage workspaces, create or reuse a local DeepSeek Harness session, and send messages through Web RPC.

description.zh: 以受限工作区权限调用 DSH headless sub-agent；支持有时限的同步/异步任务、状态查询、监控、已结束任务清理和取消。该高能力子包需显式启用。
description.en: Invoke a DSH headless sub-agent with workspace-scoped permissions; supports bounded sync/async tasks, status, monitoring, terminal-task cleanup, and cancellation. This high-capability subpackage requires explicit enablement.
